stories.title: The Big New Playground
stories.learningGoal: Preparing to visit a new place, noticing safe things, and asking for a break if it feels too big.

pages.text: This is Sam. Sam is going to a brand new playground.
First, they arrive at the playground. It is very big.
Sam feels butterflies in their tummy. Everything is new.
It is okay to feel unsure in a new place.
First, Sam finds one thing that looks safe and familiar.
It is a quiet blue swing at the edge of the park.
Then, Sam asks for a short break to sit on the swing.
The break helps. Now Sam feels ready to play.

copingCards.title: Ask for a break
steps: Notice if my body feels too fast or too big.
Go to a quiet spot together until I feel calm.
